START_EKEYD_EGD_LINUX.description: Whether to allow ekeyd-egd-linux to start.

WATERMARK.description: Number of bits minimum in the pool, below which the daemon kicks in and transfers data from EGD.

BLOCKS.description: Number of 1024-bit (128-byte) blocks to transfer to the kernel each time the pool dips below the low water mark.

SHANNONS.description: Shannons-per-byte to claim for data pushed to the pool.

RETRYTIME.description: Seconds between connection retries. Zero means do-not-retry.
